subject: Re: Encord Extra Seats
text:
Hi Seif and Shivant,

Following up on our discussion yesterday about the invoicing for the additional seats. The issue appears to come from my original understanding that the purchase of extra seats was decided on an annual basis, even when the contract defaults to annual renewal within the contracted term.
As you may recall from this email chain, our initial plan was to add the final 10 seats (seats 21-30) only for a short period of a few months. We then agreed to switch that to an annual arrangement, but I understood that we'd be able to reduce the number back to 20 at the end of that annual term.
As discussed yesterday, it seems this understanding was incorrect. I wanted to check whether there's any possibility to work something out:

  *
Short term: Is there any flexibility to cancel those 10 users for the second year of our contract?

  *
Long term: Is there anything in the roadmap to accommodate organizations with highly variable workforce sizes differently in the future?

I appreciate your help and consideration!
Best regards,
Carlos

------------------

Carlos Arteta

Head of Core Machine Learning

Optellum Ltd

http://www.optellum.com/

subject: Consolidation of Questions and Answers
text:
Hi Alex,

I am consolidating the question and answers for them in this mail thread.

Do you have any feedback on the below questions: 

1. Could you share your data formats for video & LiDAR that we would need to ingest?

Answer: Rosbags

2. I know you mentioned identifying moments e.g. tunnel in out/near collisions - how do you do this currently? Do you have a model that pre-processing, pre tags, classifications or an embeddings model to find these with an element of human review? 

Answer: Based on the signal variation delta change from start of the event to time when the 

event ends and Sensor fusion logic.

Sensor Fusion Logic and Signal variation(signal Vision, Radar and Lidar).
 There are sensor fusion algorithms (e.g., Kalman filters, deep neural networks, or Bayesian fusion) to integrate data from multiple sensors. The goal is to reduce uncertainty and increase confidence in event detection. 

Example: Tunnel-in and Tunnel-out

• 

The system detects transitions by observing environmental and localization data changes:

• 

Camera/light sensors: Sudden drop or rise in ambient light intensity.

• 

GPS/GNSS: Signal degradation or loss inside the tunnel, then reacquisition upon exit.

• 

IMU: Provides us with motion readings that confirm continuous vehicle movement even when GPS drops.

• 
There are different internal teams(Radar team, Lidar team) which consume this inform to interpret in the HIL (Hardware in Loop) or SIL systems (Software in Loop system)

Humar review exists through the Evaluation/Validation teams who use proprietary tools to visualize these signals independently from each sensor perspective and also view integrated systems.

There is also a Data mining team whose E4 ((thomas.hoernlein@mercedes-benz.com). They need visualization of pre-processed data wherein the Rosbags go through ETL pipeline and Team has automated tagging algorithms on the data collected for pattern analysis.
